<br>
The '''League of Legends World Championship 2024''' (also known as '''LoL Worlds 2024''' or just '''Worlds 2024''') is the crowning event of League of Legends esports for the year. The tournament includes 20 teams from all regions of the game in a months-long race for the Summoner's Cup. 

The tournament will start the Play-Ins and Swiss Stages in the Riot Games Arena in Berlin, Germany. For the Knockout Stage the event moves to the adidas arena in Paris, France and the Grand Finals will be played in the O2 arena in London, England.

==Format==
* '''Qualification'''<ref name="Worlds 2024 format">{{cite web|url=https://x.com/lolesports/status/1829949966283915630|title=Worlds is back! Here's everything you need to know about the #Worlds2024 format.|author=LoL Esports|date=2024-08-31|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
** 20 teams from professional leagues will qualify for the event.
** LPL and LCK will have 4 slots, while LEC and LCS will have 3 slots, PCS and VCS will have 2 slots, remaining slots will be one each for CBLOL and LLA.

* '''Play-In''' - ''September 25<sup>th</sup> - 29<sup>th</sup>''
** Eight teams play a Double Elimination bracket
** All matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 4 teams}} advance to Swiss Stage.
** {{Bgcolortext|down|Remaining teams}} are eliminated.

* '''Swiss Stage''' - ''October 3<sup>rd</sup> - 7<sup>th</sup> and 10<sup>th</sup> - 13<sup>th</sup>''
** Four teams from the Play-In Stage join twelve teams with direct entry from China, South Korea, Europe and North America
** 16 Team Swiss System Format
*** Round 1 teams will be paired against teams from a different region
*** Rounds 2 to 5 are seeded based on each team win-loss record
*** Elimination and Advancement matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** All other matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}.
*** Each team can face an opponent only '''once''' throughout the Swiss Stage.
**{{Bgcolortext|up|Teams that reach 3 wins}} advance to Knockout Stage.
**{{Bgcolortext|down|Teams that reach 3 losses}} are eliminated.
** Throughout the Swiss Stage, side selection will be determined by initial draw pool - the higher pool will receive side selection. 
** In matches between teams from the same draw pool, side selection will be determined by team's drawing order.

* '''Knockout Stage''' - ''October 17<sup>th</sup> - 20<sup>th</sup>, October 26<sup>th</sup> - 27<sup>th</sup> and November 2<sup>nd</sup>''
** Eight teams play in a single elimination bracket.
** Side Selection Privilege
*** Teams with Side Selection Privilege can choose the side in game 1, after that, the losing team can choose the side in the next game.
*** In Quarterfinals, Side Selection Privilege will be granted to teams with better match record in Swiss Stage. In the case where both teams have the same match record, Side Selection Privilege will be determined by the order teams are drawn in Quarterfinals.
*** In the following matches, the Side Selection Privilege will be determined by coin flip.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.

===Worlds 2024 Draw Show===
* The Worlds Draw Show will be held after [[LEC/2024/Finals|LEC Season Finals]] to place teams into groups for the Play-In Stage of the 2024 World Championship.<ref name="#Worlds2024 Play-In Stage Draw Show">{{cite web|url=https://x.com/lolesports/status/1829887523340108221|title=Tune in for the #Worlds2024 Draw Show after the #LEC Grand Final on September 1st!|author=LoL Esports|date=2024-08-31|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
** ''[https://youtu.be/s1JNuujOBIs Click here to watch the Play-In Draw Show video] (Guest for the Draw: {{player|Odoamne|flag=ro}})''
** <span class="mw-customtoggle-Playin-Draw" style="border-bottom:1px dotted;">''Click here for detailed information about Worlds Draw Show''</span>
<div class="toccolours mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-Playin-Draw" style="margin-top:10px;">
* Teams are splited into 2 seed pools to ensure quality matchups.
** 8 teams are splited into 2 pools
*** '''Pool 1''' will consist of LEC3 (''MDK''), LCS3 (''100''), VCS1 (''GAM''), and PCS1 (''PSG'').
*** '''Pool 2''' will consist of VCS2 (''VKE''), PCS2 (''SHG''), CBLOL1 (''PNG''), and LLA1 (''R7'').
* The first round of the Play-In will always be played against a team from a different Pool.
* No more than two teams from the same region can be in the same half.
</div>
*Swiss Stage Draw Show will be held after the completion of the Play-In and each round of play.
** ''Click links below to watch the Swiss Stage Draw Show videos: <br> [https://youtu.be/jvtongF0IK4 Round 1] - [https://youtu.be/74w77WSLgqA?t=3689 Round 2] - [https://youtu.be/Z-5dyjIB8Pc?t=3531 Round 3] - [https://youtu.be/qigmJvywXpo Round 4] - [https://youtu.be/Vxrpe2ryejQ Round 5]<br> (Guests for the Draw: Rounds 1-4: {{Flag|br}} [https://x.com/RiotWalu/status/1840696387622879526 Malu] & Round 5: Nick Weatherlow)''
** <span class="mw-customtoggle-Swiss-Draw" style="border-bottom:1px dotted;">''Click here for detailed information about Swiss Stage Draw show''</span>
<div class="toccolours mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-Swiss-Draw" style="margin-top:10px;">
* Teams are splited into 4 seed pools to ensure quality matchups.
** 16 teams are splited into 4 pools
*** '''Pool 1''' will consist of LCK1 (''HLE''), LPL1 (''BLG''), LEC1 (''G2''), and LCS1 (''FLY'').
*** '''Pool 2''' will consist of LPL2 (''TES''), LCK2 (''GEN''), LEC2 (''FNC''), and LCS2 (''TL'').
*** '''Pool 3''' will consist of LPL3 (''LNG''), LCK3 (''DK''), LPL4 (''WBG''), and LCK4 (''T1'').
*** '''Pool 4''' will consist of 4 Play-In Stage winners (''MDK'', ''GAM'', ''PNG'' & ''PSG'')
* Pool 1 teams will face Pool 4 teams, while Pool 2 teams will face Pool 3 teams in the first round.
* No team will play a team from their own region in the first round.
* Following the first round of play, there will be another draw for the second round to pair teams with the same record against one another
* Each team will face an opponent only once throughout the Swiss Stage.
</div>
* Quarterfinal matchups will be decided by an on-stage draw following the final day of the Swiss Stage. 
** ''[https://youtu.be/91pAEJO73GM Click here to watch the Quarterfinals Draw Show video] (Guests for the Draw: {{Flag|br}} [https://x.com/RiotWalu/status/1840696387622879526 Malu])''
** In this draw, teams that advanced with a 3-0 record will be matched against teams that advanced with a 3-2 record. 
** The remaining teams will then be matched against one another.
